decisions.reason: The certified HVAC plate heat exchanger line sits close to the core portfolio, and the certification investment has already been made, so management attributes the lack of visible results to temporary market conditions such as the pandemic and keeps it despite its absence from the website.
The marine box cooler line is publicly tied to a claimed major market share and is central to the firm's marine positioning, so the visible commitment makes withdrawal unlikely.

The multi-model compact oil cooler line represents a development investment built on established know-how that management continues to justify, even though it has not been visible on the website recently.
The finned tube is a core component for the firm's air coolers and supports its own production, so dropping it would undermine the established business.
The enhanced tubes embody the firm's R&D and efficiency claims and fit its announced innovation direction, so management stays committed to them.
